abstract_enriched: DonorsChoose, based out of New York City, helps teachers and public school classrooms get the funds they need for projects.

DonorsChoose had a very complicated system to help teachers find and 'purchase' the very specific materials they needed for their classroom, which led to a challenging user experience and teachers dropping off before completing their request.
From 37% of new teachers successfully submitting projects, the organization has seen a jump over just one quarter to 48%.
keyhighlights_enriched: From more than 90% completing every other step, only about 75% of users made it past the shopping stage.
The organization deployed Algolia in stages over six months, while they built a customized solution for their teacher shop.
Starting with Algolia InstantSearch, the organization has implemented Click & Conversion Analytics, and Rules, and will soon be using Dynamic Re-Ranking and AI features.

With the Algolia-powered functionality in place, teachers can now use the online shop to search and find anything DonorsChoose can supply them, from a host of more than 580,000 indexed products and over one million SKUs.
That's a 30% year-over-year increase in conversions for new teachers (and even higher on mobile).
